pre_stated_distinctness.selection_note: Primary C230 candidate RTE_OVER_WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS (WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS = Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness (sample, bias-corrected) of lengths of qualifying WHITE diagonal segments of consecutive 0s/non-recurrent, length>=w_min=2, pooled over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0); grep-zero non-self confirmed at run time. Distinct from WHITE_DIAG_LINE_COUNT_VARIANCE(C229; sample variance (ddof=1) of cnt_k_white over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0), DIAG_LINE_COUNT_VARIANCE(C228), WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_DIVERGENCE(C227), WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE(C226), WHITE_DIAG_LINE_COUNT_DIVERGENCE(C225), WHITE_DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_VARIANCE(C224), WHITE_DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_DIVERGENCE(C223), DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_VARIANCE(C222), DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_DIVERGENCE(C221), and prior C125-C229 families. RTE_OVER_WHITE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_SKEWNESS not used C125-C229.
